title: C1: promotion cache-busting — displays.json marker + unsigned v param
description:
Plan: .agents/plans/2026-09-05_16-34-obsidian-down-last-good-cache.md — Workstream C (epic tk-vau).

Server-side pick-up is already instant (admin shares the PVC; display kind served byte-for-byte). The 24h staleness is URL-level: promote() rewrites the same latest.png path and serve.ts:28 stamps max-age=86400 → browsers + Cloudflare edge keep the old image.

1. promote() (src/asset/studio.ts:110) additionally records <DATA_DIR>/displays.json: { "<entity>/<face>": <epoch-ms> } via writeJsonAtomic (src/store.ts:59). Admin process has DATA_DIR (same pod, shared PVC).
2. displayVersions(dataDir) helper with 30s TTL cache (mirror loadGames, src/games.ts:44); renderHome (src/index.ts:102) loads once per render, passes the map into collectionPage props.
3. signedDisplay (src/views.tsx:14) appends &v=<epoch> when the map has the game+face. v is deliberately UNSIGNED: verifySigned (src/asset/auth.ts:37) covers only path+w+h — no auth change; unsigned v only keys the cache. Spines inherit via signedSpine (views.tsx:26).
4. No serve-route change: unique v per promotion makes max-age=86400 correct per-URL. Bare stable latest.png keeps current behavior for Obsidian embeds.
notes: promote() gains optional dataDir -> notePromotion writes <DATA_DIR>/displays.json {entity/face: epoch} via writeJsonAtomic; displayVersions() 30s-TTL reader (loadGames pattern); renderHome passes map into collectionPage; signedDisplay/signedSpine/coverSrc append unsigned &v=<epoch> (verifySigned still path+w+h only). Live e2e on fresh local instance: promoted game renders &v=<epoch>, second render same v, /asset URL with v -> 200 image/jpeg, non-promoted games unchanged. Tests: studio.test.ts marker (setSystemTime, deterministic), views.test.tsx URL formats. Full touched-file suites green.
acceptance_criteria: Unit: promote writes/updates displays.json (extend studio.test.ts with temp DATA_DIR); views test asserts signedDisplay embeds v when provided. Local: run admin + app, promote a candidate, hard-reload → new art immediately; second render keeps same v. Full bun test green.
